description: This file contains a function to truncate session JSONL files after compaction, removing summarized message entries while preserving session state and metadata. It handles file archiving, re-parenting of entries, and atomic file writing.

methods.name: truncateSessionAfterCompaction
methods.description: Asynchronously truncates a session file after compaction by removing summarized message entries, optionally archives the original, and rewrites the file atomically.
